# AutoCite

AutoCite is an open-source, local-first legal citation checker for supported Bluepages and Whitepages citation mechanics.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://zgbrenner.github.io/autocite/
- Download: https://zgbrenner.github.io/autocite/download/
- Private Citation Risk Scan: https://zgbrenner.github.io/autocite/citation-risk-scan/
- Methodology: https://zgbrenner.github.io/autocite/methodology/
- Privacy: https://zgbrenner.github.io/autocite/privacy/
- Guides: https://zgbrenner.github.io/autocite/guides/
- Source: https://github.com/zgbrenner/autocite

## Capabilities

- Reviews supported legal citation patterns in DOCX, searchable PDF, Markdown, and TXT workflows.
- Separates Bluepages practitioner review from Whitepages academic review.
- Applies only supported deterministic mechanical fixes automatically.
- Preserves non-citation prose and validates exact source spans before edits.
- Runs standard desktop review locally with no application telemetry.
- Can optionally retrieve CourtListener opinion text when deep review is explicitly enabled.

## Important limitations

AutoCite does not guarantee complete Bluebook compliance. It does not determine good-law status, proposition support, controlling authority, precedential weight, or whether a quotation is fair in context. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Bluebook, CourtListener, Free Law Project, any court, school, journal, or law firm.
